text: Nativus Company Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of CR Verlinvest Health Investment Limited (CRVV), a joint venture 50% owned by Verlinvest S.A. and 50% owned by Blossom Key (Hong Kong) Holdings Limited.
short: Nativus is wholly owned by CR Verlinvest Health Investment, a 50/50 Verlinvest–Blossom Key joint venture.

source.name: Oatly Group AB — Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR), Item 7.A, footnote (1)
source.quote: Nativus Company Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of CR Verlinvest Health Investment Limited
source.note: The same footnote continues: 'a joint venture that is 50% owned by Verlinvest S.A., a company incorporated in Belgium, and 50% owned by Blossom Key (Hong Kong) Holdings Limited'.

additionalSources.name: A&O Shearman — Allen & Overy advises Nativus on the USD10 billion IPO of Oatly
additionalSources.quote: Allen & Overy has advised Nativus Company Limited (Nativus), a joint venture formed by Verlinvest and a leading Chinese state-owned enterprise, as the majority shareholder in Oatly Group AB (Oatly)
